definitions.gloss: full speed; top speed; at maximum speed
definitions.explanation: The fastest possible speed one can move. Almost always used adverbially with で to mean 'at full speed.'

examples.japanese: {全速力|ぜんそくりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
{全速力|ぜんそくりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{追|お}いつかれた。
examples.english: I fled at top speed but was caught up to.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{合図|あいず}→合図：01675_aizu⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧{全速力|ぜんそくりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{校庭|こうてい}→校庭：04147_koutei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{駆|か}け{抜|ぬ}けた→駆け抜ける：06114_kakenukeru⟧。
examples.english: At the signal, the children sprinted across the schoolyard at full speed.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (all, full), {速|そく} (speed), and {力|りょく} (power). Almost always used with the particle で as {全速力|ぜんそくりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (at full speed). Primarily describes running, but can apply to vehicles, swimming, and other movement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全速力|ぜんそくりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to run at full speed
- {全速力|ぜんそくりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧: to flee at full speed
- {全速力|ぜんそくりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{駆|か}ける→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧: to dash at full speed
- {全速力|ぜんそくりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧: to head somewhere at top speed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧: full power, all one's might — broader, applies to effort in general, not just speed
- ⟦{最高速度|さいこうそくど}→最高速度：17987_saikousokudo⟧: maximum speed — technical, used for vehicles and specifications
- {猛|もう}ダッシュ: mad dash — colloquial, emphasizes a sudden burst of sprinting
